text: がんばって　はこを　どけた　かいが　あったのじゃ！

structure.jp: がんばって　はこを　どけた
structure.en: working hard to move the boxes aside

structure.jp: かいが　あったのじゃ！

patterns.name: 〜かいがある
patterns.explanation: An action plus かいが ある says the effort paid off. どけた　かいが　あった = 'moving them was worth it'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: がんばって　はこを　どけた　かい
patterns.explanation: The words before かい say which effort was worthwhile. はこを　どけた　かい = 'the reward for moving the boxes'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のじゃ is the old-man form of のだ, which adds feeling, like 'I tell you'. あったのじゃ = 'it really was there, I tell you'.
